source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project. Native observations are separate from mathematical expectations.
notes: 50 native observations, 48 accepted full-LCD/status key replays; two nested-scientific-square layout/Goto frames retained as referenceOnly. Saved directly to project.

Calculate normalizes values below 1e-99 to zero after each step. Multiplying again, taking sqrt, using Ans and dividing by an underflowed denominator were measured. The exact rational path retains 1/3 in 1e-100+1/3 and Ans*3=1.

At unit scale, cancellation retains 1e-14, 1e-16 and 1e-18, but returns zero at 1e-19, 1e-20, 1e-23 and 1e-99. Independent scaled holdouts around 1e9 retain 1e-9 and return zero at 1e-10. This supports the existing 18-place relative cancellation rule; it is not a claim about every internal operation.

9.9999999999e99 is valid and stored beyond the ten displayed digits. Ans-9.999999999e99=9e89. Norm displays 9.999999999e99, Sci 3 displays 9.99e99, Sci 1 displays 9e99; changing format retains the stored value. Negative ceiling display measured too.

Intermediate overflow in (1e50)^2/1e99 is Math ERROR even though division would return to range. Its result frame is accepted; input square layout and Back cursor are deferred. Very deep symbolic/numerical combinations remain outside this set.
